LanguageData.CC_Clock_Summary: Timed over {0} of game time since this game was loaded. Over the day below, Rimfolk's passes took {1} ms of each tick on average.
LanguageData.CC_Clock_Reading: Each line is one of Rimfolk's regular passes, the most costly first. Runs are how often it came round and did its work; one that waits for something (a visit, a letter, an answer playing out) runs only while there is one. Times are real milliseconds on this computer. The hour and the day are the last whole ones once the clock has seen one, and the one so far until then. Per run is the average since the game was loaded, and the worst run the longest single one. Nothing here is saved. Hover over a line to see when it runs.
